<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1428
Claimant:
Gregory Hopkins
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
10-28-23
Rear-end collision reported at a signalized intersection; insuerd vehicle was struck from behind while stopped, and
the at-fault driver's carrier has been notified. Claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact is being
routed through the attorney's office.
11-22-23
Reviewed the scene photos and statements from two independent witnesses, who both describe the impact and
sequence of events the same way the claimant and the other driver did. The vehicle damage to the rear bumper and
trunk area is consistent with the described impact.
4-16-24
Confirmed the driver involved is listed on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time of loss. No prior
damage to the vehicle is on file, and nothing in the records points to earlier impact or pre-existing body damage to the
vehicle.
4-22-24
Claimant's medical records were received showing a wrist fracture, which is a plausible injury for this type of impact.
The treatment course followed a usual pattern and tapered as the claimant improved. A prior records check shows a
minor strain in the same general area years ago that resolved fully with no lasting effects.
4-26-24
Claimant's attorney provided a written account that adds some small details not in the first recorded statement,
though the core account of the collision has stayed consistent across all statements. Seating position in the vehicle at
impact is not fully clear from the records and will be clarified in a follow-up interview.
5-28-24
Spoke with counsel to request the follow-up interview on seating position and to confirm the timeline of treatment.
Counsel indicated the claimant will attend within the next two weeks and that updated treatment notes will be
forwarded.
6-1-24
Reviewed the file with the injury evaluation and damage estimate in hand. Claim remains open pending the follow-up
interview and receipt of updated treatment records, with no current indication of any coverage issue.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
